fields.description: Optional JS condition to show this field only when relevant, e.g. eval:doc.asm_along=='Yes' (native frappe-ui depends_on). Multi-branch eval expressions can be long.
fields.label: Depends On

fields.description: Compiled from the type's rules — do not type here. The condition under which this field is required (native frappe-ui mandatory_depends_on); a hidden field is never required.
fields.label: Mandatory Depends On

fields.description: Where this field's value lives. Activity: on the task, in the section named below. Lead: on the lead, through the lead's own catalog and entitlement — never copied onto the task.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The section this field's answer lands in. Its CRM Task Section row names the doctype whose column the Target below is.
fields.label: Section

fields.description: Optional: the column on the section's Target DocType this field writes to. Blank = stored as an answer row addressed by its fieldname.
fields.label: Target
